{{Quote|You were the executive officer of the Star Destroyer ''Forger'' when it suppressed a rebellion on Gra Ploven by creating steam clouds which boiled alive two hundred thousand Ploven in three coastal cities.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], to [[Davith Sconn]]|<ref name="SoL" />}}
The '''Bombardment of Gra Ploven''' occurred during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. By the time of [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the planet [[Gra Ploven]] rebelled against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TCSWE-Forger" /> The native [[Ploven]] refused to pay the expected contribution to the Imperial defense assessments.<ref name="SoL" /> In retaliation, [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Dureya]] ordered the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Forger]]'' to execute a punitive [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] and targeted the lakes and seas of the planet with its [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]].<ref name="TCSWE-GraPloven" /> The resulting steam clouds boiled alive two hundred thousand Ploven in three coastal cities. Grand Moff Dureya's [[Executive officer/Legends|executive officer]] [[Davith Sconn]] was later blamed for the massacre and forcibly retired from the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].<ref name="SoL" />
